texto.@es: En una noticia local, distingue el cambio ocurrido de las opiniones de los vecinos.
texto.@en: In a local news, it distinguishes the change that occurred from the views of the neighbors.

texto.@es: 동네에 자전거 길이 생겼어요. 주민들은 편리하다고 말해요. = Se construyó un carril bici en el barrio. Los vecinos dicen que es cómodo.
texto.@en: 동네에 자전거 길이 생겼어요. 주민들은 편리하다고 말해요. = A bike lane was built in the neighborhood. Neighbors say it's comfortable.
